race.title: 3A's Leisure Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: PURE CARBON developed into a much better chaser than hurdler last season, typically travelling well when recording his third success of the campaign at Stratford in April, and he can pick up where he left off with his yard back amongst the winners. He gets the vote ahead of Rula Bula , who is better judged on the promise of her chasing debut effort. PURE CARBON RULA BULA (IRE) CENTARA (IRE)
